offering_description.value: Designs, sources and markets branded apparel, footwear and accessories, mainly under licensed and owned Calvin Klein and Tommy Hilfiger names. Sells to department and specialty stores, to consumers through its own stores and websites, and to licensees and distributors worldwide.

primary_products.value: men's, women's and children's apparel; underwear and intimates; jeans; footwear; fashion accessories and fragrances (via licensees)

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual shoppers buying through own retail stores and e-commerce sites; B2B: department stores, specialty retailers, online retailers, wholesale partners, licensees and distributors

end_markets.value: apparel; footwear; fashion accessories; consumer lifestyle brands

revenue_model.value: product sales: wholesale sales to retailers and direct retail sales of apparel and accessories; licensing or royalties: royalties from licensees making fragrances, eyewear, watches, home goods and other products

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs and markets branded apparel made by contract manufacturers, sold to retailers and consumers; retailer: operates own brand stores, outlets and e-commerce sites selling to consumers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America and the Middle East

specialization.value: related lines: Calvin Klein and Tommy Hilfiger brands across apparel, underwear, footwear, accessories and licensing

distribution_channels.value: third-party retail: department stores, specialty stores and online retailers carrying wholesale products; own locations: owned full-price and outlet stores; online: brand e-commerce websites; partners / resellers: licensees and distributors in international markets
distribution_channels.category: third-party retail; own locations; online; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: low: Normal business rules plus customs and trade tariffs, product safety and labeling, and labor sourcing standards
